summary: Canonical task state has no parseable epm:smoke-architecture-check marker.
The upload entrypoint was exercised only with --dry-run and no production-outroot unit was attested.
The fit driver writes its done sentinel before any B5 upload of JSON or tensor outputs.
Harvest/all require prep_output.json that is not uploaded or staged onto the VM or analysis pod.
Sidecar, drop_stats, and pinned-map keys are indexed without complete early runtime coverage checks.
All condition mu.pt inputs collapse onto one resume-fingerprint dictionary key.
The ceiling floor check ignores cells with zero retained rollouts and does not reconcile kept plus dropped slots.
B3 uses nested trigger/question/rollout loops despite the plan's batched-matmul contract.
